description: Batch sizes of the KernelBench level 2 problem 98 module (in_features = out_features = 8192, pool 16, scale 2): its five get_inputs() batches 256..4096 plus 16, 32, 64 and 128 so the performance cases span 256x. Batches 100 and 1000 (and 1000 with a negative scale) are correctness-only boundary shapes; the declared minimum batch is 16 (see README.md).
